# yet Provider

Every product of a [Yet](https://yet.com.br) company — its Settings, its Cloud — as code. An API key, made in Yet in **Preferences → API keys**, names the company and acts as its person: the provider does what they may do, and nothing more.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    yet = {
      source = "yetlabs/yet"
    }
  }
}

# The key comes from YET_API_KEY when api_key is left out. Make one in Yet:
# Preferences → API keys.
provider "yet" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key, `yet_<company>_<secret>`. Falls back on `YET_API_KEY`.
- `base_domain` (String) Yet's domain: `yet.com.br` unless set, or `YET_BASE_DOMAIN`.
- `cloud_url` (String) Yet's API, every product's: `https://cloud.<base_domain>` unless set, or `YET_CLOUD_URL`.
